experiment: XPC-B stage 2 (Person 3): person-balanced batches + cross-person supervised contrastive loss

dataset.name: UCI HAR (Human Activity Recognition Using Smartphones)
dataset.note: train and test files are concatenated, then windows of each subject are selected (data_preprocess_ucihar.load_domain_data)

protocol.folds: leave-one-person-out over persons 0-4: target t held out, the other 4 are sources
protocol.source_split: per source person and activity, the last 20% of that activity's windows (file order) -> validation; train windows overlapping a validation window (50% sliding overlap, detected from sensor values) are purged; zero overlap asserted (6 purged per person)
protocol.selection: epoch with max mean source-validation accuracy; tie -> lower source-validation CE_y. Target data never used for training, lambda, selection or probes
protocol.target_metrics: accuracy, macro-F1, weighted-F1 at the selected epoch (primary); last epoch and mean of last 10 epochs (secondary); best-on-target epoch logged as DIAGNOSTIC only
protocol.probes: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression (linear) and StandardScaler + MLP(64, random_state=seed); fit on source-train posterior means, scored on source-validation; person<-z, activity<-z_d, person<-z_d; leak guard asserted (0 shared, 0 target windows)

arms.ie_off: stage-1 control, person-sequential single-person batches; used ONLY as the reproducibility anchor (target 0, seed 0)
arms.ie_off_bal: single Adam, main GILE loss, person-balanced batches (16 windows x 4 source persons per step; steps/epoch = sum_p floor(n_p/64), same as stage 1)
arms.xpc_bal: ie_off_bal + lam * L_XPC on the posterior mean of z through projection head g (50->64->32), tau = 0.1

hyperparameters.lam_rule: lam = 0.1 * mean main loss per batch / mean L_XPC per batch at initialisation, source persons of target 0, seed 0, CPU; fixed for all runs (code/stage2_xpc/lambda.json)
hyperparameters.sampler: per person WeightedRandomSampler(weights = 100/class count, replacement=True, generator seed = seed*100 + k)
hyperparameters.projection_head_init: torch.manual_seed(10000 + seed) under fork_rng of CPU and all CUDA states

design.primary_contrast: xpc_bal - ie_off_bal (paired per target-seed, averaged within target, 95% t-interval over 5 targets)
design.predeclared_success_rule: accuracy improves for >= 4 of 5 targets AND both person<-z probes (linear, MLP) decrease for >= 4 of 5 targets; lower probes with worse recognition = failure; otherwise inconclusive / harmful
design.analysis_plan_after_interruption: PRIMARY = seeds 0,1,2 (pre-planned reduced design) if the full 50 are not available; SENSITIVITY = all complete pairs. If all 50 complete on T4, report the full 50 as the pre-planned preferred design and the seeds 0-2 subset alongside.

environment_reference.stage1_and_stage2_T4: Colab Tesla T4, torch 2.14.1+cu130 (anchor matched stage 1 exactly)
